pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions on the flank with serrated pixel-level edge gradients. Patch size is largest on the upper torso, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower flank and ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological web of light-colored negative space. Pathways form a structured mesh with distinct multi-path junction nodes. Width of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly toward the rear.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder line, appearing as a short, dark, continuous fringe.
